text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruits, vegetables, and whole grains. Try to avoid too much sugar and fast food. Second, exercise regularly. Even a short walk every day can help you feel better. Third, get enough sleep—about eight hours for most adults. Don't forget your mental health. Talk to friends, relax, and take breaks when you feel stressed. Finally, keep a good work-life balance. Spend time on hobbies and with family. When you care for all these areas, you will feel happier and stronger.
